bars.says: A visitor recognises a pale fungal woodland by its towering caps, ground-level biolight and milky pools under the tile’s actual sky, and can identify ordinary forage and hazards in it.

meant.intent: Land must visibly embody the selected mushroom cathedral and its local ecology. Recognisable forage and hazards make the picture usable.
meant.source: Owner-selected TheRot row in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md. Frozen the_rot.md sections 1, 4, 4b, 9. Delegated readability inference from ordinary colony use.

figurative.stands_for: A canopy and low cover made entirely from fungi, with existing giant cap architecture.
figurative.accept: An irregular fungus-only stand with overlapping caps and no conventional trees remains a woodland in this sense.

accept: An irregular stand of overlapping pale caps surrounds low glowing cover and milk shallows, with dark gaps between biological lights. Ordinary forage and a cloud-emitting Prime are recognisable on approach.
At the warm shoulder the actual low sun lights the same fungal structures, and the Sheen is named and shown as fungal sleet.
reject: A dark vanilla woodland has a pale tint, while its edible plants and danger patches disappear beneath opaque cap art.
Ordinary blue marsh and water rain occupy the described milk ponds and Sheen weather.
bars.lazy: none: Land and life readability. The sentence requires the actual fungal structures, useful light, fungal liquid identity and recognisable forage/hazards, closing the tinted-vanilla and display-only alternatives.

range.varies: Authored Rot shoulder arc 74..135 and historical ambient -42..24 C from the frozen sheet, using actual fixed-tile illumination. Natural stand densities at current defaults and mature overlap extremes. Clear/SheenFall/SheenStorm/SheenMist/DryThunderstorm, transition into each, dry and wet ground, normal play zoom and close inspection. All selected art variants are eligible, with no required variant count.
range.left_out: Planet placement and planetary tile counts. Color approval or regeneration of previously owner-kept art. Literal temple geometry.

bars.says: Colonists meet a self-sustaining fungal food web whose forage, predators, tame products and flying natives work through ordinary harvesting, hunting and husbandry, with readable animal deaths and departures.

meant.intent: The life roster must function as encountered ecology and useful husbandry across its ordinary lifecycle. Standing flight and readable-loss rules are part of that experience.
meant.source: Frozen the_rot.md sections 4, 6 and 7b. Standing native-water, flight, no-vanishing and no-evictions rulings. Dustveil answer in rot_open_questions_2026-10-22.md. Delegated ordinary-lifecycle completeness.

figurative.stands_for: Across the season the roster keeps eating, breeding, hunting and being refilled by ordinary wild spawning, without starving out or flooding. This is functioning open ecology, not a closed population maintained solely by births and diets.
figurative.accept: Ordinary wild-spawner arrivals replace predation losses while resident animals continue feeding, breeding and hunting; the population need not replace all losses through births.

accept: Foragers gather fungal food and building stock while predators feed in their usual habitat. Tamed brogg produce milk and tended dustveils yield silk through their normal lifecycle.
A native flyer crosses an obstacle by actual flight. A wounded native dies with a corpse or a readable death sign, while surviving animals remain accounted for after a reload.
reject: The roster is a static selection of named bodies that never eat, reproduce, yield products or hunt.
A moth bobs visually against a wall, or surplus wild giants silently disappear when the population cap runs.
bars.lazy: none: Life. Named roles must function through ordinary actions and real flight, with traceable deaths/departures. Decorative bodies and helper-created yields fail.

range.varies: Every current free-tier resident including body-only hwelgrue, plus historical external durrok/mullgoth when dependencies resolve. Colony 1..40, population from normal initial spawn through a season of births and predation. Every fictional flyer includes thozzik colony/queen forms, illoth and dustveil. Ordinary Prime/Skulltop approach, cut and escape. Actual flight observations only in an owner-present session.
range.left_out: Kin healing/wound transfer, chittik implantation, giant swallowing, medical prizes, new animal assignments and perfect static population balance. Historical campaign species are a dependency uncertainty until composed state is read.

accept: A cold mat-floored bedroom lets the player run backup heating for less of its routine than in a matching inert-floor bedroom at the same occupied-room temperature, without feeding the ground.
Across the cold shoulder the player still provides insulation, clothing or heating despite the help from living floor.
reject: All rooms receive a global warm-biome offset whether they have living floor or inert flooring.
The mat produces a negligible thermometer twitch with no useful change to heating work, or makes the cold shoulder routinely comfortable without other protection.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires a practical reduction in routine backup heating linked to enclosed living floor, together with remaining cold protection. A thermometer twitch alone cannot satisfy that routine change.

Default heat settings, then off as a separate check.
range.left_out: Portable roots, warm pawn auras, sunlight overrides, outdoor ground-temperature simulation and guaranteed self-sufficient heating at the cold end.

bars.says: Players lose raw food and organic remains left exposed to the Rot’s digestion even in freezing air, while walled and roofed storage protects them from that accelerated loss.

meant.intent: The gut is a reliable practical consequence of exposure across the full cold-to-warm biome. Shelter is an effective response.
meant.source: Frozen the_rot.md section 3 rot clock promises exposed meat gone within a day, but section 3 Thermogenesis describes Frostcaps as the starved, freezing edge, with cold ground starving or dead. rot_kit_spec.md M2 deliberately routes progress through RotRateAtTemperature and targets warm unrefrigerated meat. Kit owner card 2 confirms walled-plus-roofed exemption. Delegated default, not an owner ruling: extend exposed digestion through freezing despite that contrary evidence, prioritizing the absolute rot-clock wording. Owner-pages question Q1 records both readings and the consequence of changing this default.

figurative.stands_for: The biome’s accelerated, exposure-driven destruction of organic stores and remains, readable in item/corpse state.
figurative.accept: An exposed meat stack visibly loses its digestive freshness and disappears without a moving mouth or gut organ.

accept: An exposed frozen meat stack shows digestive loss and is consumed while the matched enclosed stack retains ordinary cold preservation.
A roofed lean-to loses exposed perishables until the player finishes its walls. Outdoor corpse and filth disappear through readable decomposition while indoor cleaning remains ordinary.
reject: The test uses warm meat alone, while exposed frozen stores survive indefinitely.
A roof canopy alone removes the digestive hazard, or a completed store receives the same accelerated loss as the open ground.
bars.lazy: none: Signature hunger and its shelter response. Explicit freezing and walls-plus-roof close the temperature-zero and lean-to loopholes.

bars.says: Over a season in the complete Rot, a colony can keep using fungal shelter, harvest and storage while the forest and its native food web renew, with understandable losses and workable routes through weather changes, a reload and reordered colony work.

meant.intent: Whole first-version play must remain a functioning cold fungal place with metabolic help and hunger operating together. A stable staged slice is insufficient.
meant.source: Delegated from owner whole-system requirement in this brief, the selected Rot experience, frozen ecosystem/thermogenesis/rot-clock intent and standing no-vanishing rule.

accept: The settled colony hauls and cooks, its living-floor rooms save heating, and stored fungal food requires cooling decisions while the full forest grows, local hazards run and native animals feed and reproduce.
After saving during active harvest and reloading, expanding storage before harvest and harvesting before expanding storage both yield understandable consequences and recoverable colony work.
reject: A staged colony looks stable because weather, local gas, wet-native growth or digestion is locked or disabled.
Growth and gas consume the usable forest, native animals starve away, routine jobs stall, losses have no readable cause or recurring errors drown out play.
bars.lazy: none: Whole land, life and signature. Complete default operation, explicit change/save/work sequence and renewal close disabled-system showcases, static dioramas and supply-cache masking.

range.varies: Exactly the complete first version at factory defaults with all kept systems on and unlocked, next-version extras off. Full supported maps from 200..400 cells per side, flat/rocky/milk-shallows layouts, authored cold/middle/warm shoulder regimes, all actual weather states with natural selection left running, initial and mature stand density. A full 15-day in-game season, paired starts with 3 and 40 colonists, then a 100-day M4 extension to detect delayed drift. Save/load around day 7 during held harvest/haul and room changes. Main sequence enclose/store/harvest/cool then harvest/enclose/cool/store in a fresh sibling run. Compression only accelerates elapsed ticks or a calibrated offline integration step, preserving job scheduling, pawn metabolism, weather selection/RNG, plant/animal cadence, deadlines, room rebuilding, damage, reproduction and save clocks. Any skipped system invalidates the live reading. Natural rare states may be covered by M1 sibling fixtures in addition to the uninterrupted season, never by replacing its weather schedule.
range.left_out: Deferred quests, rituals and exotic rewards. Subjective enjoyment. Exact equilibrium populations, yields, time budget or variant totals. Planet generation or canonical save changes.

checks.what: Snapshot resolved source/assembly/art/settings/engine and composed mod fingerprints before any proof. Current proposal claims no gameplay fingerprint agreement.
Use existing donor-name, selectable, glower, live-prep, Dustveil and cartoon-retirement selftests as scoped regression readings. Field/asset counts are diagnostics, outside passing bars.
Read inherited positive animal/plant density, actual element-form rosters and default weather pool. Keep current authored density intent without making exact density or variant counts bars.

Retain the frozen sheet raw-meat exposure deadline of 60000 ticks across -42..24 C. Room exemption matches walled-plus-roofed owner card 2. Frozen exposure status and final destruction are read independently.

Record warm-floor terrain set, configured required floor fraction, offset and max room temperature. Current source comments/extension contract use a 21 C ceiling and 250-tick sweep. Confirm actual resolved values before comparison.

Record living-produce attachment on RM_Glimmerslime/RM_RawDulcis and stack-to-room aggregation. Source default heatPerUnit is 3.5 per 2000-tick sweep. Zero XML attachments found in this checkout is a binding gap, not gameplay proof.

Read missing-field and old-settings migrations, new default-off opt-ins, actual job/incident/letter/effect suppression, all-off load and per-feature restore. Unrelated shared engine consumers must retain their behavior.

For every fictional flyer record resolved MaxFlightTime, tracker capability and directional flip-book assets. Existing paused state test is capability evidence only. Actual flight judgment obeys owner-present rule.

Count ordinary product/lifecycle/food-chain events by entity identity, including eggs, larva metamorphosis, asexual reproduction, gas-emitter tick callbacks and milk/silk jobs. Direct helper invocation is recorded separately.
Record current giant contact masks, flips, growth scales, footprint/texture fingerprints and resolved selection bounds. Reuse HugeThings tools, with off-map/model assumptions calibrated before trust.

Record initial inputs, harvest/consumption, room heat/cooling, usable routes, active weather durations and error rate over the season. Reloaded sibling and reordered-work sibling preserve settings and ordinary tick semantics.
Confirm automated worker/mutator planetary placement is disabled permanently. Existing fixed world and zero-tile owned biome state need no repair.

Retain deferred owner numeric rulings as checks for the opt-in branch, including annual age reversal, pale-tree psylink cap, gear slowing exposure, portable mat feeding/budding, wild-only blastpod and the accepted empty-alarm waiver.

rules.rule: Version selection is metabolic colony life. All existing animal roster entries remain. Animal special systems may be dormant independently of their bodies. All DLC and the common engine composition are assumed.

Use the existing engine room/exposure concepts subject to the owner walled-plus-roofed contract. Floor membership is re-derived after construction, merge, split and reload. Door traffic uses actual engine room/temperature behavior.
Native mat supplies bounded ordinary room heat with no food or exhaustion inside Rot. Existing offset, ceiling and floor threshold remain tunable checks. Direct Sun remains the shared geometric rule.

Exposed raw meat follows the frozen sheet digestive deadline at every supported ambient temperature. Enclosed food gets ordinary vanilla preservation. Only rottable items, corpses and outdoor filth participate. Keep corpse gear/holder processing consistent with vanilla and Bones contracts.

Bind the existing living-produce extension to the intended glimmerslime/raw-dulcis products. Per-room aggregation follows actual spawned stacks and ordinary temperature. Product moves, consumption and stack changes alter the next scheduled contribution.
Reuse current giant art and HugeThings contact math for placement/pathing/selection. Preserve owner dense-giant intent, with routes and work validated after growth or destruction.

Retain ordinary fungal food, wood substitute, fibre, medicine and native milk/eggs/silk/lifecycles. Native drinking follows the shared environmental-water ruling. Gas from resident Prime/Skulltop and ordinary animal toxin attacks stays. Shared spawner admission must preserve readable existing animals.
Keep wet fungal emission weather and its existing wet/fire effects, with natural rotation unlocked. Use authored tile geometry for sun. Ordinary biological glowers and goo lights illuminate the dark.
Keep ExplosiveGrowth existing wet-native Churn and immortal exceptions. Milk wet-source classification, regrowth and giant placement must be checked together through the existing engine APIs.
Keep passive Wreckage/Bones/AcousticScanner integration. A scanner reading must describe enabled resident content. Special core clues, loot and quests require next-version opt-in.

Each moved extra requires an explicit off-by-default next-version gate, normal-entry acquisition/effect suppression and safe legacy save conservation. Keep defs and source. All-off is a playable ordinary biome. Existing unsupported cross-biome switches stay off.

The whole reading runs all kept mechanisms through normal jobs and tick schedules at shipped defaults. Live motion of native flyers requires the standing owner-present session. Compression must preserve every named scheduler and saved transition.

meetings.why: Dense giant contacts, wet-native turnover, gas patches, wrecks and colony building all compete for the same routes. Pairwise open clearings cannot establish full-map reachability after a growth/room transition.
